[title] Survey Results Summary statistics Quantiles and boxplots Python/Colab Outlook Quantiles (cont.)
[body] Certain quantiles are equivalent to others:
[body] m = Q2 Q1 Q3
[body] • The median is the second quartile Q2 • The 25th percentile is equivalent to the first quartile Q1
[body] Questions
[body] 1 Quintiles (QU1, QU2, . . .) partition a distribution into 5 equal groups.How many quintiles are there?
[body] 2 The second quartile Q2 can be expressed as which percentile?a
[body] Answers: Q1: There are 4 quintiles; Q2: Q2 = P50 (fiftieth percentile)
[body] aRecall that a quartile splits a sample into 4 equal groups.
[body] Prof. Oke (UMass Amherst) CEE 260/MIE 273 M1b: Summarizing Data September 10, 2026 12 / 16

FIGURE: [description of the image, not printed words] A horizontal row of ten evenly spaced dots. The third dot is red and has a downward red arrow labelled “Q₁”; the sixth dot is blue and has a downward blue arrow labelled “m = Q₂”; the eighth dot is red and has a downward red arrow labelled “Q₃”. The remaining dots are black.
